Privacy Policy

1. Summary

  • We collect what we need to run Kontaro: your account details, billing details and the messages and contacts you manage in the app.
  • For your customers’ messages, we act on your behalf (as your processor). You decide what is collected and why.
  • We do not sell personal data, and we don’t use your customers’ messages to train AI models for other customers.
  • You can access, export or delete your data. Contact talk@kontaro.ai.

2. Who is responsible

Kontaro Inc. (830 Brickell Plaza, Miami, FL 33131, United States) is the controller for personal data about website visitors and account users (our customers and their team members). For personal data about our customers’ own customers (for example WhatsApp contacts and conversations), our customer is the controller and Kontaro is the processor (operator under Brazil’s LGPD), processing that data only on the customer’s instructions.

3. Data we collect

  • Account data: name, email, company, phone, password (stored hashed), language and settings.
  • Billing data: plan, invoices and payment status. Card details are handled by our payment processor (Stripe) and are not stored by us.
  • Customer Data you manage in Kontaro: contacts, messages, media, campaign lists, files and spreadsheets you connect (for example from Google Drive), and AI configuration.
  • Usage and technical data: logs, device and browser information and IP address, used for security and to keep the Service working.
  • Website: if you fill in the sign-up form, your name and email. The website stores your language choice in your browser. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies on this website.

4. How we use it

  • To provide, maintain and secure the Service, including sending and receiving messages and generating AI replies and insights.
  • To create and manage your account, verify your email, bill you and provide support.
  • To send service notices, such as billing, security and changes to our terms. Marketing emails only with your consent, and you can unsubscribe anytime.
  • To comply with law and enforce our terms.

Legal bases (where GDPR or LGPD apply): performance of a contract, legitimate interests (security, service improvement), consent (marketing) and legal obligations.

5. Service providers and AI

We share data with providers that help us run the Service, under contracts that protect it. They include Meta (WhatsApp and Instagram messaging), cloud hosting (for example Render), AI model providers that generate replies, Stripe (payments), email delivery providers and Google (only if you connect Google Drive). AI providers process message content only to generate responses for you and, under our agreements, do not use it to train their models. A current list of subprocessors is available on request.

6. International transfers

Kontaro is based in the United States and our providers may process data in the US and other countries. When we transfer personal data from Brazil, the EU/UK or other regions, we rely on appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses, as required by applicable law.

7. Retention

We keep account and Customer Data while your account is active. After you cancel, we delete or anonymize Customer Data within 90 days, except where we must keep certain records (for example invoices) by law. You can export your data before cancelling.

8. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, delete or restrict the use of your personal data, to object to certain uses, and to withdraw consent. This includes the rights under Brazil’s LGPD (Lei 13.709/2018), the EU/UK GDPR and US state privacy laws such as California’s. To exercise them, email talk@kontaro.ai. If your data was collected by one of our customers (for example, you messaged a business that uses Kontaro), please contact that business; we will help them respond. You may also complain to your data protection authority, such as the ANPD in Brazil.

9. Security

We use encryption in transit, access controls and monitoring to protect data. No system is completely secure, and we will notify affected customers and authorities of a personal data breach as required by law.

10. Children

The Service is for businesses and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

11. Changes and contact

We will post updates to this policy here and, for material changes, notify account owners by email. Contact: Kontaro Inc., 830 Brickell Plaza, Miami, FL 33131, United States · talk@kontaro.ai.
